2026_03_BAL_DAL.headline: Baltimore’s pressure game challenges Dallas in a matchup built around quarterback efficiency
2026_03_BAL_DAL.paragraph1: Baltimore and Dallas arrive with offenses capable of creating explosive plays, but the deciding issue is likely to be how cleanly each quarterback operates when the pocket compresses. The Ravens can use their run game and movement concepts to keep Dallas from attacking obvious passing downs. The Cowboys need to protect long enough for their receivers to work vertically, while their defense must prevent Baltimore from turning early-down efficiency into sustained scoring drives.
2026_03_BAL_DAL.model_rationale: Baltimore’s ability to stay multidimensional can reduce obvious passing downs, while Dallas needs protection and explosive completions to keep the game from tilting toward the Ravens.
